prompt:
Hi — I'm trying to get a proper handle on all the devices we have running on our office network (192.168.1.0/24). I need three things done:

1. Go through the devices already discovered on the network and assign clear, human-readable labels to the important infrastructure devices: the main router/gateway, our NAS/storage unit, and the office printer. Use whatever identifiers make sense to identify each one.

2. Check if any new devices joined the network in the last 60 minutes and make a note of what you find.

3. Export the complete device inventory (with all the labels you've assigned) and save it as a file called `network_inventory.json`.

We want to make sure the labels are properly saved so they don't get lost.
